title: Analysis and Compensation of Current Measurement Errors in Machine Drive Systems—A Review
author: Pingyue Song; Tao Wang; Lijian Wu; Hao Li; Xiang Meng; Cheng Li
locator: Current sampling and measurement error mechanisms; current-controller effects and torque pulsation
license_or_permission: CC BY 4.0; repository stores metadata/link only
notes: Review states current measurement errors can affect current-controller accuracy and produce electromagnetic torque pulsation, current ripple and mechanical vibration. Specific error mechanisms and mitigation depend on drive topology and sampling implementation.
